novelty.justification: The claim hypothesizes that “some facts are stated correctly but not used” while others are “used correctly to drive a decision but cannot be stated,” with the stronger mechanism that these directions occupy “partially distinct internal loci”; its novelty route is therefore a bidirectional phenomenon plus causal representational separation, not merely a new benchmark setting. Searches using “LLM articulate versus use knowledge double dissociation,” “tacit knowledge used but cannot state language model,” “knowledge utilization gap implicit downstream task,” and “activation patching explanation answer causal dissociation” identified nearby work such as Physics of Language Models Part 3.2 on acquisition-versus-utilization and Towards Faithful Natural Language Explanations (EMNLP 2024) on activation-patching-based explanation faithfulness, but neither proposes opposite off-diagonal say/use populations together with direction-specific causal interventions. Moving from those one-way utilization or explanation–answer gaps to a bidirectional causal double dissociation requires a new core relationship rather than a direct transfer, although the broader dissociation framing and intervention tools are established, supporting high rather than paradigm-level novelty.
